overview.en:
Discover, fetch, pay, and track Bharat Connect bills through Setu's official hosted Bill Payments MCP.

Check bill details and payment status before preparing a bill-payment workflow. Keep the biller and reference identifiers attached to the result.

Complete the connection or local-runtime setup described by this plugin before using service tools. Results depend on the tools exposed to your account; specify the target resource and report scope when starting a task.
overview.zh-CN:
查询、支付和跟踪 Bharat Connect 账单。

在准备账单支付流程前核对账单详情与支付状态，结果中保留账单机构与参考编号。

使用服务工具前，按插件说明完成连接或本地运行环境配置。结果取决于账号可用工具；开始任务时请说明目标资源与报告范围。

starterPrompts.en: Look up this bill and summarize its due date and amount.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 查询这张账单，汇总到期日与金额。

starterPrompts.en: Check the payment status for this bill reference.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 检查这个账单编号的支付状态。

starterPrompts.en: Prepare the steps for paying this bill without submitting payment.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 准备支付这张账单的步骤，先不要提交付款。
